Normal systolic <120 mmHg. (Not from NASA specific report, based on general clinical reference).
Normal diastolic <80 mmHg. (Not from NASA specific report, based on general clinical reference).
Normal QTc is <450ms for men. General clinical knowledge.
Normal QTc is <460ms for women. General clinical knowledge.

lens_dose_30d.label: Dose to lens of eye - 30 days

source.document: Risk of Cardiovascular Adaptations Contributing to Adverse Mission Performance and Health Outcomes
source.note: Prevents radiation-induced cataracts (vision impairment). While sub-clinical cataracts from low-dose GCR are considered an acceptable risk, severe acute cataracts must be prevented.

Worst case: complete obstruction needing 72-168 h (3-7 days) of treatment. Best case: 0-72 h.
Moderate to severe course: Clinical Phase II lasts 24-120 h. Best case: 0-24 h.
Needs repeated or indwelling catheterisation: 24-120 h. Best case: 0-24 h. Catheterisation failure risk under 1% may require medical evacuation.

conversion_factors.description: Relative Biological Effectiveness (RBE) multipliers. Used by the system to convert raw dosimeter readings (mGy) into Equivalent Dose (mGy-Eq) for non-cancer effects.
conversion_factors.formula_note: Calculation: Absorbed Dose (mGy) * RBE multiplier = Equivalent Dose (mGy-Eq)
